name: CAD2GIS
description: DWG/DXF to GIS, QGIS delivery and source-preserving CAD tools with validation evidence.
details: Local stdio MCP for validated DWG/DXF-to-GIS workflows. Four optional CAD wrappers expose 15 verified tools through an independently installed MIT runtime. Edits preserve the source and return to CAD2GIS acceptance. Existing nine examples are CONDITIONAL; absolute accuracy is not verified.
